title_zh: 国际社会如何看中国科技
title_en: How the World Sees Chinese Technology
note_en: An embedded either-or question uses 还是 without any question mark: 往往取决于观察者更看重突破的速度，还是更看重瓶颈的深度 "often depends on whether the observer cares more about the speed of breakthroughs or the depth of bottlenecks." English needs "whether ... or" after "depends on," but Chinese simply drops the two options, joined by 还是, straight after 取决于.
